stemMd: Three labels describe a box: label P says it contains a red ball; label Q says it contains no red ball; label R says it contains a blue ball. Exactly two labels are true. What must be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The box contains no red ball.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The box contains a blue ball.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The box contains a red ball.

explanationMd: P and Q are exact negations, so exactly one is true. To reach a total of two true labels, R must also be true. Red-ball presence remains undetermined.

distractorRationale.e: Either P or Q can be the true member of their pair.
distractorRationale.b: Either P or Q can be true.
distractorRationale.d: That would make only Q true.
